text: Southwire Company, LLC has been owned by the Richards family since its founding in 1950; the family's message on the company's site says 'As owners, we are proud of the company's legacy', and the company states it is currently owned by family members.
short: Southwire is owned by the Richards family (family-owned since 1950).

source.name: Southwire: Family Owned (A Message from the Richards Family)
source.quote: Southwire is a family-owned company operating in a globally competitive industry. As owners, we are proud of the company’s legacy and good standing in the community
source.note: The same page also states: 'Currently, the company is owned by family members and governed by a ten member board of mostly independent directors.' Page undated; the date given is the day the page was opened. No state or state-fund owner.
